? A 48-year-old gun-wielding man shot by _Peel_ _Regional_ _Police_ officers last week at his Mississauga home has died.
The Special Investigations Unit said the man, whose identity has not been released, died early yesterday in hospital from gunshot-related injuries sustained in the incident last Friday.
_Police_ had been called to the home on after a caller reported gunshots. The man was shot when he ignored warnings not to move.
